material.acceptance_criteria: On origin main: ci.yml has no push-triggered job that runs cargo or node test.js; tests.yml triggers on workflow_dispatch only and carries the moved jobs; pages.yml deploy depends on no test job. ci-status on the closing sha is success for ci and pages. Push CI wall-clock is recorded before and after the change.
material.description: Owner decision (user, session drain-ci-policy-12): maximise parity and CI speed; tests are not what we value. Every test job moves out of push CI into .github/workflows/tests.yml, which runs on workflow_dispatch only: the rust workspace tests, the wasm32 and wasip3 compile, the native and wasm state-hash parity, the map export determinism check and the wire codec round-trip. Test source files stay in git and are not deleted. Push CI (ci.yml) keeps the static client checks and gains the browser smoke of the built page. pages.yml keeps the build, the static gate, the deploy and the first-draw gate; its wire gate moves to tests.yml.

references.note: {"url":"https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/events-that-trigger-workflows#workflow_dispatch","repo":"github/docs","path":"content/actions/using-workflows/events-that-trigger-workflows.md","sha":"","why":"workflow_dispatch is the documented manual-only trigger: a workflow with only this event never runs on push, so tests can leave push CI without deleting their files","license":"CC-BY-4.0"}

material.subject: CI decision: tests move to an on-demand workflow, push CI keeps static checks, the browser smoke and the first-draw gate
material.witness: On a090c61de494fbf936e83d4963f317cf086bbc65: ci.yml push jobs are static and browser-smoke only (no cargo test, nextest, node test.js, parity or wasm-hash command); tests.yml triggers on workflow_dispatch only and carries rust, wasm, parity, maps, wire; pages.yml has no gate-wire and deploy needs build and gate-static. CI wall clock: ci before 122 s (cd85d6d7, run 40183575808, workspace tests 119 s critical path), after 42 s (a090c61d, run 40185215763) and 33 s (febeb25d, run 40185447900). On-demand tests run 40185187860 (a1ec90d0, workflow_dispatch) success in 94 s. Pages run 40185215769 success.
material.witness_plan: gh api reads of the workflow triggers on the closing sha, plus ci-status {sha} green for ci and pages with run ids and durations.
